mad.byTitleHint.en: Every title your launches promote, with what its ads cost and brought. Open a title for its campaigns and ads.
mad.byTitleHint.zh: 投放推广过的每部剧集，以及其广告的花费与带来的结果。打开剧集可查看它的广告系列和每条广告。

mad.byTitleEmpty.en: No launch has created a campaign yet. Titles appear here once a launch is out.
mad.byTitleEmpty.zh: 还没有投放创建过广告系列。投放发出后，剧集会出现在这里。

mad.unattributed.en: {n} campaign(s) with several titles not added in yet
mad.unattributed.zh: {n} 个含多部剧集的广告系列尚未计入

mad.unattributedLong.en: {n} campaign(s) promote this title alongside other titles, and TikTok has not reported their ads separately yet, so their numbers are not added in. Refresh to read them again.
mad.unattributedLong.zh: 有 {n} 个广告系列同时推广此剧集和其他剧集，TikTok 还没有单独报告其中每条广告的数据，因此这些数字尚未计入。可点击刷新重新读取。

mad.adStatsNone.en: No numbers for this ad yet

mad.adStatsFailed.en: This ad's numbers could not be read (see below)
mad.adStatsFailed.zh: 未能读取这条广告的数据（见下方）

mad.adStatsUnavailable.en: TikTok's per-ad numbers could not be read this time: {reason}. The campaign's numbers above are not affected.
mad.adStatsUnavailable.zh: 这次未能读取 TikTok 的单条广告数据：{reason}。上方广告系列的数字不受影响。

mad.adIdHint.en: crazydramas' own dashboard lists visits and purchases by this id (as the creative).
mad.adIdHint.zh: crazydramas 自己的数据面板按此 ID（即 creative）列出访问和购买。

mad.titleSub.en: Every launch, campaign and ad that promotes this title, and what they cost and brought.
mad.titleSub.zh: 推广此剧集的每次投放、每个广告系列和每条广告，以及它们的花费和带来的结果。

mad.counts.zh: 投放 · 广告系列 · 广告

mad.secondSource.zh: 第二来源：crazydramas 自己的数据

mad.secondSourceHint.en: crazydramas.com counts the visits and purchases that arrive from these ads itself (series {slug}), by TikTok campaign id and ad id. Its numbers come from its own tracking, so they will not match TikTok's attribution exactly.
mad.secondSourceHint.zh: crazydramas.com 会自己统计来自这些广告的访问和购买（剧集 {slug}），按 TikTok 广告系列 ID 和广告 ID 列出。它的数字来自自己的跟踪，因此与 TikTok 的归因不会完全一致。

mad.openDashboard.zh: 打开 crazydramas 数据面板 ↗

mad.titleEmpty.en: No launch has promoted this title yet. Launch ads for it, and their numbers appear here.
mad.titleEmpty.zh: 还没有投放推广过此剧集。为它投放广告后，数字会显示在这里。

mad.partCampaign.en: Shares the campaign with other titles: only this title's ads are counted
mad.partCampaign.zh: 与其他剧集共用广告系列：只计入此剧集的广告

mad.partCampaignUnread.en: Shares the campaign with other titles, and its ads have no numbers of their own yet
mad.partCampaignUnread.zh: 与其他剧集共用广告系列，其广告暂无单独数据

mad.adsHint.en: An ad's numbers include any copies TikTok made of it. Purchases are TikTok-attributed (Website purchases launches only).
mad.adsHint.zh: 每条广告的数字包含 TikTok 为它生成的副本。购买为 TikTok 归因（仅网站购买投放）。

mad.fromLaunchesSub.en: {launches} launch(es), {campaigns} campaign(s), {ads} ad(s) promote this title.
mad.fromLaunchesSub.zh: 共有 {launches} 次投放、{campaigns} 个广告系列、{ads} 条广告推广此剧集。

mad.adWebUnavailable.en: Per-ad purchases could not be read this time: {reason}. Each ad's cost and clicks above are not affected.
mad.adWebUnavailable.zh: 这次未能读取单条广告的购买数据：{reason}。上方每条广告的花费和点击不受影响。

mad.unattributedMeta.en: {n} Meta campaign(s) with several titles not added in
mad.unattributedMeta.zh: {n} 个含多部剧集的 Meta 广告系列未计入

mad.unattributedMetaLong.en: {n} Meta campaign(s) promote this title alongside other titles. Meta reports numbers per campaign, not per ad, so their numbers are not added in here; the campaign's own numbers are on the Monitor.
mad.unattributedMetaLong.zh: 有 {n} 个 Meta 广告系列同时推广此剧集和其他剧集。Meta 只按广告系列报告数据，不按单条广告，因此这些数字没有计入这里；广告系列本身的数字见投放监控。
